Acne & Acne Scars

Acne & Acne Scars

Evidence-led acne care and considered scar treatment — for active breakouts and their after-effects.

Book a Consultation Explore the treatment
Sessions
Acne: ongoing; scars: 4–6
Downtime
None–48 hours
Consultation
By appointment

Acne is common, but the reasons behind it vary — and so does the right treatment. We treat the active breakouts first, then address the marks and texture they leave behind.

Active acne and acne scars are two different problems that need two different plans. Treating scars while skin is still breaking out wastes time; clearing breakouts without addressing texture leaves the reminder behind. We do both, in order.

How it works

Assessment of acne type and severity, medical management of active breakouts, then a staged approach to post-acne marks and texture once skin is stable.

Who it is for

Anyone with active pimples, cysts or persistent congestion, or leftover red marks, pits or uneven texture after acne.

Concerns it addresses

Whiteheads, blackheads, inflammatory breakouts, hormonal acne, post-acne redness, marks and textural scarring.

Treatment process

  1. Acne assessment and severity grading
  2. Active-breakout treatment plan
  3. Home routine and lifestyle review
  4. Scar and texture phase once skin is clear

Expected results

Active acne improves over weeks to months; scar treatment is planned only after skin is stable, and expectations are set per scar type.

Preparation & aftercare

Before the treatment

Bring a list of products and treatments you have already tried.

After the treatment

Do not pick or squeeze — it is the single biggest cause of avoidable scarring.
